title: Outstanding Oven Roasted Portuguese Chicken Stew
description: A funky and springy Portuguese dish featuring jam and nimono-simmer, this ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly stew is a crowd-pleaser. It combines the flavors of chicken, vegetables, and spices in a sweet and savory broth.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to brown.
Stir in the quince jam, chicken broth, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast for 30-40 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the stew from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
